ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'About their deeds' refer to in Surah Al-Hijr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the angels' inquiry into the specific deeds of the people of Lot, serving as a precursor to divine judgment. It underscores the theme of accountability, where human actions are meticulously recorded and questioned before the ultimate reckoning.
